visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with blonde hair in braids, wearing a pink long-sleeved shirt and a yellow knit sweater draped over her shoulders, is meticulously searching through rows of colorful books on a tall wooden bookshelf. The indoor setting features warm, soft lighting, with dried flowers and framed artwork visible on the walls, suggesting a cozy bookstore or cafe environment. (2) Two men enter the frame; one wears a grey 'ROOTS' brand hoodie and the other wears a light beige jacket over a mint green shirt. They engage in a conversation with the woman, who points toward the shelf. The camera zooms in slightly as a large graphic overlay of a book titled '鬧著玩' with a yellow cover and various food illustrations appears on the screen. (3) The scene shifts to a medium group shot where the men gesture enthusiastically toward the camera. The man in the beige jacket speaks with high energy, his hands moving to emphasize his points. The background remains the same cozy indoor space with framed art pieces featuring intricate patterns. (4) The man in the grey hoodie takes center stage, holding up his hand to indicate three fingers while smiling brightly. The woman stands in the background, observing and reacting to their conversation. Text overlays appear frequently at the bottom, highlighting pricing and discount information in a variety-show style. (5) The camera returns to the woman standing by the bookshelf; she strikes a playful pose with her hands on her hips and a wide smile. The man in the grey hoodie looks at her with a look of mock disappointment, eventually making a dismissive hand gesture as the video concludes.

(2) A female voice responds with a hesitant, slightly drawn-out 'I'm looking for that...', which is immediately interrupted by a second male voice. This new voice is much higher in arousal and pitch, excitedly announcing the book title with high intensity. The BGM continues steadily in the background without pause. (3) A third male voice joins in, delivering information about the book's release date and platform in a professional, narrative style. His speech rate is moderate and his articulation is very clear. The music remains at a consistent volume, providing an energetic bed for the spoken information. (4) The voices of the group merge briefly as they chant a call to action, encouraging fans to help the book reach the top of the charts. The vocal arousal is high here, with an optimistic and joyful valence. There are no significant SFX during this informational segment. Upon her reveal that it hasn't been shot yet, the man emits a sharp, dismissive 'Tch' sound effect, which serves as a comedic punchline to end the audio track.
